Facts used:
- Harrowfield’s 2025 household water use was 7,146 megalitres, and its 2025 census population was 90,212 residents. [NR-07]
- Ossbridge’s 2025 household water use was 3,862 megalitres, and its 2025 census population was 52,904 residents. [NR-01]
- The 2025 household water tariff was 142.35 tenge per cubic metre. [NR-15]
- One megalitre equals 1,000 cubic metres. [NR-15]

Calculations:
- Harrowfield water per resident = 7,146 × 1,000 ÷ 90,212 = 79.212503...
- Harrowfield payment per resident = 79.212503... × 142.35 = 11,274.391...
- Ossbridge water per resident = 3,862 × 1,000 ÷ 52,904 = 72.988433...
- Ossbridge payment per resident = 72.988433... × 142.35 = 10,390.403...
- Difference = 11,274.391... − 10,390.403... = 883.988..., which rounds to 883.988 tenge per resident.

ANSWER: Harrowfield | 883.988
